name: bookmarks
title: Bookmarks
description: Search the bookmarks of every browser you use, plus links of your own, and open one in the browser it came from. A second list searches your browsing history.
author: pal

settings.label: Bookmarks file
settings.description: A JSON array of {name, url, subtitle?, icon?, keywords?}; the url is opened or copied. Optional: without the file the browsers alone are listed.

settings.label: Browsers
settings.description: Whose bookmarks to list, in order (the first wins a url two have): chrome, brave, edge, chromium, vivaldi, arc, safari, firefox. Empty lists the file alone.

settings.label: Exclude folders
settings.description: Bookmark folders skipped, by name (`Archive`) or a short path (`Bookmarks Bar/Old`).

store.tagline: Bookmarks from every browser and your own links, in one search
features: Chrome, Brave, Edge, Chromium, Vivaldi, Arc, Safari and Firefox, every profile
Your own links from a JSON file, with names, keywords and icons
Found by name, address or folder; a link saved twice is listed once
Open it, open it in the browser it came from, or copy it plain or as a markdown link
Browser History: search pages you visited in Chrome-family browsers and Firefox, newest first

screenshots.caption: The file's links first, then each browser in its section, the folder on the right
A folder name is a keyword: typing it finds what is filed under it
Open in browser, Copy link, Copy as markdown, Open in Chrome
Browser History: what the browsers visited, searched by title and address, newest first with when; Enter opens it in the browser it came from

actions.title: Open in browser
actions.description: The system's default browser. Every action here works on several marked rows: they open together, copies go one per line.

actions.title: Open in Chrome, Safari, Firefox
actions.description: On a browser's row: the browser it came from.

actions.title: Open in Chrome, Firefox (history)
actions.description: On a Browser History row: the page in the browser it came from.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks
bookmarks.description: The links in the file and the browsers, by name, folder and keyword.

history.title: Browser History
history.description: What the browsers visited (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Chromium, Vivaldi, Arc, Firefox; every profile), searched by title and address on every keystroke, newest first; the last visit on the right. Each browser's history file is copied under pal's cache before it is read, since a running browser holds it locked; the copy follows the file, at most every 30 s. Safari's history needs Full Disk Access and is not read.

keys.title: Open in the browser it came from
